searchText: should we have shanghai dedicated channel? We discussed that on the last ACD and the rough consensus was that we should probably have one when ACD calls start again. In the meantime, we can use this channel, but given we're pausing the calls for people to take some time to rest, we didn't want to create another high-volume one for people to monitor. So, 🔜 ! I'm not really convinced there was "rough consensus". I think only you and I commented on it and everyone else was silent, and you and I disagreed but Tim trumps Micah. I must have slept over that part 😉 I think most people take a nap when Tim and Micah disagree on ACD. 😆
